prompt: I've been collecting meeting transcripts for the past quarter and want to understand my communication patterns. Please analyze all transcript files in this directory and provide a comprehensive meeting insights report. The report must be saved as 'communication_analysis.md' and include: 1) A summary of conflict avoidance patterns with specific examples, 2) Speaking ratio analysis showing my percentage vs others, 3) Filler word frequency analysis, 4) Active listening indicators, 5) Leadership facilitation effectiveness, 6) At least 3 actionable recommendations for improvement. Each pattern should include timestamped quotes from the transcripts and explain why the behavior matters.
